coach.morning_action: Trinke jetzt {{oz}} ounces. Erneut prüfen in 25 Minuten. Du startest im Defizit.

coach.peak_action: Score {{score}}. Peak. Trinke 8 ounces vor der nächsten Einheit. Halte die Linie.
coach.peak_explanation: You're locked in — notice what peak feels like. Add a stick if the heat or your effort ramps up.
coach.peak_explanation_heat: You're locked in, and the heat's pulling harder than usual — don't let your guard down.

coach.peak_explanation_streak: You're locked in and riding a real streak — this is what consistency builds.
coach.balanced_action: Score {{score}}. Balanced. Trinke jetzt 12 ounces. Erneut prüfen in 45 Minuten.

coach.balanced_explanation_heat: You're holding steady, but the heat's raising the bar — stay a step ahead of it.
coach.balanced_explanation_sleep: You're holding steady after under 6 hours of sleep — staying a step ahead of your next drink keeps it that way.
coach.balanced_explanation_streak: You're holding steady and stacking days — that consistency is doing the work.
coach.recovering_action: Score {{score}}. Erholung. Nimm jetzt 1 Stick mit 16 ounces. Erneut prüfen in 20 Minuten.
coach.recovering_explanation: Tendenz fällt. Dreh die Kurve, bevor sie beschleunigt.
coach.recovering_explanation_heat: Recovery window opening, and the heat's speeding it up — a water cycle now matters more.
coach.recovering_explanation_sleep: Recovery window opening after a short night — a water cycle now helps you catch up.
coach.depleted_action: Score {{score}}. Erschöpft. Trinke jetzt 20 ounces und nimm 2 Sticks. Erneut prüfen in 10 Minuten.
coach.depleted_explanation: Tiefes Erholungsfenster. Wasser und Elektrolyte unterstützen deine Erholung.
coach.depleted_explanation_heat: Deep recovery window, and the heat is pulling harder than usual. Electrolytes now are the priority.
coach.depleted_explanation_sleep: Deep recovery window after a short night. Electrolytes now help you catch up.
coach.social_drink_water_action: Trinke jetzt 12 ounces Wasser. Halte 30 Minuten Abstand zum nächsten Drink.

coach.social_take_rtd_explanation: Recovery window opening. Electrolytes now make tomorrow morning easier.

coach.social_slow_intake_explanation: 30+ Minuten Abstand zwischen Drinks hält den Score stabil und den Morgen klar.
coach.social_recovery_action: Trinke 20 ounces Wasser und nimm 1 RTD vor dem Schlafen.
coach.social_recovery_explanation: Erholungsfenster geöffnet. Zwei Einheiten Flüssigkeit + Elektrolyte jetzt machen den Unterschied.
coach.social_stop_explanation: Du bist in einem stark beeinträchtigten Bereich. Wechsle zu Wasser und starte das Erholungsprotokoll.

v2.gap_note: Celtic sea salt is minimally processed and retains a broad spectrum of naturally occurring trace minerals. It is philosophically aligned with AForce — unprocessed and ocean-sourced like our algae ingredients.

v2.cite_formula_source: Source: Sawka MN et al. 2007. ACSM Position Stand. Med Sci Sports Exerc 39(2):377–390.
v2.cite_thresholds_body: >2% body weight loss → measurable performance decline; >4% → heat-illness risk.
v2.cite_thresholds_source: Sources: ACSM 2007 (Sawka MN et al. Med Sci Sports Exerc 39(2):377–390); Cheuvront SN, Kenefick RW. 2014. Compr Physiol 4(1):257–285.
v2.cite_ranges_body: Sweat sodium spans ≈ 10–90 mmol/L (≈ 230–2070 mg/L) across athletes, with wide individual variation.
v2.cite_ranges_source: Source: Baker LB. 2017. Sports Med 47(Suppl 1):111–128, Figure 2.
v2.cite_strategy_body: Replace 100–150% of fluid loss within 4–6 h post-exercise; pair sodium intake with fluid for full re-equilibration.
v2.cite_strategy_source: Source: Sawka MN et al. 2007. Med Sci Sports Exerc 39(2):377–390; Maughan RJ, Shirreffs SM. 2010. Scand J Med Sci Sports 20(Suppl 2):59–69.
v2.cite_estimate_body: Anchored to per-sport population-mean sweat rates (Baker 2017; sport-specific values from Maughan 2007 and Godek 2010), scaled by Du Bois body-surface area, RPE-mapped intensity, USARIEM-style climate factors, and Périard 2015 acclimatization adjustment.
v2.cite_calibration: This is a modeled estimate, not a measurement — always confirm with a scale for clinical decisions. Not a medical device.
